messages:
Hannah (CS): Quick heads-up  07:07 UTC - seeing 401s on SSO token exchange for a small set of EU onboarders. Impacted: 6 trials, 2 enterprise (Loomix, Harbor). Linking roster: https://go/internal/cs/impacted-sso.
Ibrahim (eng-oncall): Looking into logs now. Provider returning invalid_client on /oauth/token. Kicked off secrets resync to secretstore-eu. ETA ~20m.
ops-bot: secret-resync: started (job-id 2026-11-09-0718)
Ibrahim (eng-oncall): Resync finished 07:32 UTC. Token error rate back to baseline by 07:35 UTC. Root cause: provider secret rotation + missing key-rotation webhook for eu-1. Plan: add rotation webhook, region smoke test, and an alert. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Hannah (CS): Drafting customer note for impacted contacts. Will ask Legal to review. Draft below.
Hannah (CS): --- CUSTOMER STATUS DRAFT ---
Hi <CustomerName>,
Were writing about a brief authentication issue some EU-based users experienced during onboarding earlier today. Service was restored for affected users as of 07:32 UTC. If you still see 401s, please try a fresh browser sign-in and include the request timestamp and the x-rw-trace header when you reply so our team can investigate quickly.
We apologize for the inconvenience. We have applied a two-week credit for affected trials and scheduled a complimentary 1:1 onboarding session for impacted enterprise accounts. To book troubleshooting office hours, please use: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/office-hours.
If you have questions, reply to this message or contact your CS rep directly.
---
Nina (Legal): OK with wording. Prefer "we apologize for the inconvenience" and keep "service was restored for affected users as of 07:32 UTC".
Clara (CS Ops): I'll send personalized notes to Loomix & Harbor and book 1:1s. I'll log any renewal signals in the renewal-risk tracker.
Diego (Product): Loomix is in renewal review in ~3 weeks. Please mark as high priority for follow-up.
ops-bot: secret-resync: success (job-id 2026-11-09-0718) - 100 keys synced
Hannah (CS): Sent customer notes at 07:45 UTC to impacted list and posted a short portal status. Will escalate any replies indicating churn risk.
